subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

FOREST : EROFTS :: LETTER : TTELRE :: SELECT : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is as follows:

• FOREST : EROFTS 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3ddc47991c2df0337314979581a3cc0dd378efa12f642e1bc78c7230156c73a.png] 

• LETTER : TTELRE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ce0ae62fa63d94f5ba244a33d622304454c530e92ce0a19e63df1d525edb943.png] 

• Similarly, SELECT : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25cfb60036f45c6bc715545f0f2eb8ee27c632dfdb58d3228e66d3c35b13f278.png] 

Hence,** 'option 4'** is the correct answer.
